what: Import Weather Station Data from APIs
title: Import Weather Station Data from APIs
text: goal wthrdat provide standardized API download data multiple weather station providers. wthrdat specifically written support agricultural decision support tools research requires real-time weather data multiple networks. wthrdat supports downloading time series data specific stations pair date-times. wthrdat currently support Synoptic Western Weather Group APIs. APIs require key. subset weather variables currently supported (precipitation, reference evapotranspiration, air temperature. use wthrdat, need know stations want, access via API key. sources ‘free’ weather data, see ‘Ways Download Weather Data R’ . Weather APIs can lot download station data. example many weather API can help discover new stations get info health station. kinds functions supported.

title: Import Weather Station Data from APIs
text: get weather data Synoptic CIMIS station Ventura County, CA. Start defining parameters request: Next call wd_getdata_syn() returns data long format: work variables individual columns, need transform wide format:
code: weather_vars <- c("pr", "eto", "tair") stn_id <- "CI152" start_dt <- lubridate::ymd_hm("2025-04-01 00:00", tz = "America/Los_Angeles") end_dt <- lubridate::ymd_hm("2025-04-30 23:59", tz = "America/Los_Angeles") ## Retrieve my API key (saved as an environment variable - see below) syn_key <- Sys.getenv("MY_SYNOPTIC_PUBLIC_TOKEN")  camarillo_tbl <- wd_getdata(src = "syn",                             stid = stn_id,                             start_dt = start_dt,                             end_dt = end_dt,                             var = weather_vars,                             key = syn_key,                             units = "imperial") #> THIS SESSION IS INTERACTIVE: FALSE #> SESSION IS NULL: TRUE #> SETTING COLORS TO 1 #> ✔ Downloaded networks from Synoptic #> ℹ Calling Synoptic API✔ Calling Synoptic API [90ms] #> ✔ Parsed data for station CI152 dim(camarillo_tbl) #> [1] 1968    7 head(camarillo_tbl) #> # A tibble: 6 × 7 #>   src   network stid  dt                  var     val units #>   <fct> <fct>   <fct> <dttm>              <fct> <dbl> <fct> #> 1 syn   CIMIS   CI152 2025-04-03 13:00:00 tair   62.7 degF  #> 2 syn   CIMIS   CI152 2025-04-03 14:00:00 tair   61.2 degF  #> 3 syn   CIMIS   CI152 2025-04-03 15:00:00 tair   60.4 degF  #> 4 syn   CIMIS   CI152 2025-04-03 16:00:00 tair   60.3 degF  #> 5 syn   CIMIS   CI152 2025-04-03 17:00:00 tair   59.2 degF  #> 6 syn   CIMIS   CI152 2025-04-03 18:00:00 tair   58.6 degF camarillo_wide_tbl <- wd_long2wide(camarillo_tbl, use_units = TRUE) head(camarillo_wide_tbl) #> # A tibble: 6 × 7 #>   src   network stid  dt                    tair   pr  eto #>   <fct> <fct>   <fct> <dttm>              [degF] [in] [in] #> 1 syn   CIMIS   CI152 2025-04-03 13:00:00   62.7    0 0.02 #> 2 syn   CIMIS   CI152 2025-04-03 14:00:00   61.2    0 0.02 #> 3 syn   CIMIS   CI152 2025-04-03 15:00:00   60.4    0 0.02 #> 4 syn   CIMIS   CI152 2025-04-03 16:00:00   60.3    0 0.01 #> 5 syn   CIMIS   CI152 2025-04-03 17:00:00   59.2    0 0    #> 6 syn   CIMIS   CI152 2025-04-03 18:00:00   58.6    0 0

title: Import Weather Station Data from APIs
text: dozen ways API call can fail. API may offline, station may offline, API key might expired, expected parameter values may changed, etc. error occurs wd_getdata() (dependent functions), checks common causes tries provide helpful error message. ’re working console notebook, error message hopefully help understand come way fix error. ’re calling wd_getdata() Shiny app (one main use cases package), probably want check error response can respond without app simply disconnect server. can trap errors present error message user Shiny app using try() function illustrated :
code: data_tbl <- wd_getdata(src = "syn",                  stid = c("CI052", "CI152"),                  start_dt = as.POSIXct("2026-03-18 13:00:00 PDT"),                  end_dt = as.POSIXct("2026-03-30 13:00:00 PDT"),                  var = c("eto", "pr"),                  key = "abcdefg",                  units = "imperial",                  tz = "America/Los_Angeles") |> try(silent = TRUE)  if (inherits(data_tbl, "try-error")) {   cat("An error occurred: ", attr(data_tbl, "condition")$message, "\n", sep = "") } else {   head(data_tbl) }

title: Get station data from Synoptic — wd_getdata_syn
text: query station data SynopticData API. documentation, see https://docs.synopticdata.com/services/ use Synoptic API, must create Public Token. details log-Synoptic account https://customer.synopticdata.com/customer/ go 'Create API keys tokens'. cross-check data availability, visit: https://availability.synopticdata.com/stations Synoptic time series endpoint (https://docs.synopticdata.com/services/time-series) support temporal resampling, per argument ignored. pass value cache_dir, downloaded data saved location. function however clear cache_dir upon closing, recommended use temporary directory.
